(a) True indicated air speed shall be used: (1) The never-exceed speed, Vnea radial red line (see § 3.739).

red line in (1) above to the upper limit of the (2) The caution rangea yellow arc extending from the red line in (1) above to the upper limit of the green arc specified in (3) below. (3) The normal operating rangea green arc with the lower limit at Vs1, as determined in § 3.82 with maximum weight, landing gear and wing flaps retracted, and the upper limit at the maximum structural cruising speed established in § 3.740. (4) The flap operating rangea white arc with the lower limit at Vso as determined in § 3.82 at the maximum weight, and the upper limit at the flaps-extended speed in § 3.742. (b) When the never-exceed and maximum structural cruising speeds vary with altitude, means shall be provided which will indicate the appropriate limitations to the pilot throughout the operating altitude range.
